svg.title: Gate Runner · The street (#24) · Direction B: Stacked Arcology
svg.text: Gate Runner · The street (#24) · Direction B: Stacked Arcology
Concept sheet · polished neon low-poly · draft art direction · cyan = squad, pink = Hush, the city stays violet / gold / off-white
Mid-distance tower, arch and signs, about 11.6 px per world unit
Tower top with rooftop neon, a sign, and an arch corner
Hush propaganda before the drop · liberated after
Cyan edge rails frame the squad's lane; beat lines pulse on the music
One every 2 bars; pulses on the beat
Ink, steel, plum and fog are Prototype 2 working shades for facets only (draft; strike them if the crew wants the ten-color palette strict).
Idea: Neon City gets its own skyline: terraced arcologies, a Hush spire with a halo ring where the sun was, octagon portal arches.
Risk: More shapes per tower; on a small phone the stepped neon and portals could crowd the gates and the swarm.
